title: Review scope and conventions
work: Record USD convention, exclusions, user workflow and reviewer role.
acceptance: Every accounting assumption has an explicit decision and unresolved questions are logged.

title: Approve data contracts
work: Review required fields and cross-record checks; add planned schema tests.
acceptance: Each input/truth validates; altered currency, decimals and malformed dates fail.

title: Create Python package
work: Install prerequisites, initialize package and declare only needed dependencies.
acceptance: Python 3.12 environment resolves; imports work; docs preserved.

title: Create test and quality harness
work: Set unit/integration/evaluation directories and lint configuration.
acceptance: One meaningful contract check runs and malformed input test fails as expected.

title: Implement CSV and JSON reader
work: Parse strict columns, integers and dates; produce row-specific errors.
acceptance: CSV and JSON normalize to equivalent business records; invalid import is atomic.

title: Implement normalization and provenance
work: Preserve originals; build evaluator-only opaque-ID projection and reverse map; normalize keys.
acceptance: Leading zeros survive; all strategies receive only allowlisted business fields and opaque IDs.

title: Implement transactional store
work: Create tables, foreign keys, canonical digests and conflict behavior.
acceptance: Same import is a no-op; changed content under same ID conflicts; rollback leaves no partial bundle.

title: Implement deterministic arithmetic
work: Add bounded sums, differences and outstanding balances with input citations.
acceptance: Exact cents and overflow tests pass; no float arithmetic.

title: Implement exact baseline
work: Match literal references; expose unlinked and ambiguous records.
acceptance: No cross-supplier link; missing reference does not cause invented match.

title: Implement rules matching
work: Add normalized references and bounded unique-candidate fallback.
acceptance: Multiple equal candidates abstain; partial payments link by reference.

title: Implement duplicate detection
work: Detect same-supplier invoice-number duplicates and block liability aggregation.
acceptance: Duplicate case flags both records; same number at different supplier is not conflated.

title: Implement amount discrepancy checks
work: Compare order/invoice and invoice/payment ledger amounts with versioned tolerance.
acceptance: Every difference has correct sign/value and input citations; boundary tests pass.

title: Implement partial payment semantics
work: Aggregate unique payments and evaluate due date, outstanding and overpayment.
acceptance: Clean and overdue variants differ correctly; exact due date is not overdue.

title: Implement missing-evidence checks
work: Check required order/invoice/ledger support; distinguish unpaid from absent invoice.
acceptance: Specific evidence request points to an observed reference; no synthetic missing source.

title: Assemble deterministic cases
work: Apply outcome precedence and retain all findings in stable order.
acceptance: Any unresolved missing source blocks clearance; clean open remains clear.

title: Implement citation resolver
work: Resolve evidence against immutable source version and validate calculation links.
acceptance: Broken, wrong-bundle or nonexistent field references are rejected.

title: Serialize versioned reports
work: Create stable report identity and schema-valid deterministic serialization.
acceptance: Repeated deterministic run produces same report content and identity.

title: Implement optional model adapter
work: Select provider; record version, timeout and usage; implement disabled/mock/live modes.
acceptance: Disabled mode makes no request; mock timeout preserves rules report.

title: Write bounded investigation prompt
work: Build model context only from sanitized inputs and computed findings; require grounded hypotheses.
acceptance: No readable source names, ancestry, splits, labels, truth or secrets enter serialized model requests.

title: Validate AI claims and fallback
work: Reject malformed or ungrounded facts; retain deterministic outcome and reason.
acceptance: AI cannot clear a flagged case or replace any authoritative amount.

title: Implement human review events
work: Append version-bound decisions with reason and idempotency key.
acceptance: Repeated request is safe; dismissal without evidence and stale versions fail.

title: Implement command-line workflow
work: Expose validate, ingest, investigate and review subcommands; wire export in T26.
acceptance: Example import and rules investigation execute from repository root.

title: Implement local HTTP adapter
work: Add local queue/case/import/review/export routes and input limits.
acceptance: Loopback app returns expected responses; invalid cases return useful errors.

title: Build case queue
work: Implement counts, filters, search and empty/loading/error states.
acceptance: Keyboard navigation works and filter counts agree with stored cases.

title: Build case/evidence view
work: Show calculations, timeline, evidence drawer, hypotheses and review controls.
acceptance: Every visible claim opens evidence; narrow screen remains usable.

title: Implement portable exports
work: Export versioned JSON and printable escaped HTML snapshots.
acceptance: Exports reproduce reviewed facts and do not execute source text as HTML.

title: Complete development corpus
work: Create 32 bundles to reach 20 clean and 20 exception; record highest shared ancestry.
acceptance: 40 unique bundles; CSV is not extra; eight seeds count as one independent lineage; oracle reviewed.

title: Create and seal held-out corpus
work: Create 160 bundles: 80 clean and 20 exceptions per category; review ancestry independence.
acceptance: No shared lineage crosses splits; evaluator-only mappings/truth and projected hashes sealed.

title: Implement evaluator and scorer
work: Run strategies, score counts/citations and retain all failed runs.
acceptance: Hand-scored miniature cases agree with computed denominators and scores.

title: Test failures and data boundaries
work: Test input faults, prompt injection, budget, renamed sources, opaque-ID permutations and label canaries.
acceptance: Source/label changes cannot alter remapped business outcomes; payload inspection proves no metadata leakage.

title: Freeze protocol and versions
work: Freeze schemas, projection, ancestry, rules, prompt, model, tolerance, seeds and audit sample.
acceptance: Freeze precedes evaluation; independent lineage count reviewed; no unresolved semantic ambiguity.

title: Run development spend pilot
work: Measure real token/cost use and set bounded run budget; do not inspect held-out.
acceptance: Budget includes retries and cumulative cap; disabled mode remains default.

title: Execute frozen comparison
work: Run 320 deterministic and 480 AI trials with complete status records.
acceptance: 800 run slots accounted for; missing/failed runs are not silently omitted.

title: Audit explanations independently
work: Two reviewers score support and adjudicate disagreements using the frozen rubric.
acceptance: Audit coverage, agreement, disputes and unresolved limits are documented.

title: Analyze and report results
inputs: all run records and audit labels
work: Report paired effects, highest-lineage clustered uncertainty, category results, cost and failures.
acceptance: All metrics have denominators; actual independent clusters reported; negative findings retained.

title: Verify fresh install and demo
work: Use a clean environment to reproduce setup, fixtures, local UI and exports.
acceptance: Setup and demo evidence recorded with actual environment and revision.

title: Collect workflow feedback
work: Invite authorized practitioner review; distinguish simulation from observed use.
acceptance: Specific usability findings and revisions recorded; absent feedback disclosed.

title: Review release and license
work: Choose license, inspect content, reconcile claims and record remaining acceptance gaps.
acceptance: Artifact status and performance status are separate; no remote created without authorization.
